events.event_hazard: Rising sea temperatures causing coral bleaching
evidence_snippets: In February this year… diving on the Great Barrier Reef to see the impact of rising water temperatures
Witnessed a highly distressed reef, covered in bleached-white staghorn coral

key_impacts: Sediment flows onto the Reef harmed coral and seagrass by restricting light
evidence_snippets: A month later Cyclone Debbie did hit
[It] caused widespread flooding in erosion hotspots causing sediment flows onto the Reef
Sediment harms coral and seagrass by restricting light
